A_separation_state_reduction.goal: Reduce inherited horizontal velocity and angular rate before free descent
A_separation_state_reduction.hypothesis: Delaying separation reduces horizontal velocity by allowing the full stack to fly more vertically before split. Fin placement affects separation attitude.

B_descent_trim_alignment.goal: Maintain body thrust axis near -v_hat during descent
B_descent_trim_alignment.hypothesis: Larger/more fins create stronger aerodynamic restoring torque, keeping nose pointed along velocity. Forward surfaces create weathercocking effect.

C_inertia_mass_distribution.goal: Reduce rapid attitude collapse and create useful rotational time scale
C_inertia_mass_distribution.hypothesis: Moving CG forward (more nose/mid ballast) increases pitch stability. Longer body increases pitch inertia, slowing collapse. Higher nose ballast creates stronger restoring torque.

D_combined_topology.goal: Combine best causal features from A-C
D_combined_topology.hypothesis: The optimal topology combines: (1) reduced horizontal velocity at separation, (2) strong aerodynamic alignment during descent, (3) favorable inertia distribution
D_combined_topology.selection_criteria: Top performer from each family A-C
D_combined_topology.variables: Combination of selected variables from A, B, C
